reason: Workspace and session management enhancement focused on sidebar navigation, file areas, previews, multi-folder workspaces, recycling, and session organization; human review is warranted because it modifies host bundles, writes workspace files, and can commit and push Git changes.

summaries.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区与会话管理增强插件，提供多文件夹、回收站、文件预览、拖拽上传及 Git 面板等界面与操作功能。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness workspace and session management enhancement plugin providing multi-folder workspaces, recycle-bin controls, file previews, drag-and-drop uploads, and a Git panel.

capabilities: Modifies DeepSeek Harness bundles through overlay patches
Reads and writes files within workspace directories
Creates, deletes, restores, and purges sessions and workspaces
Executes Git branch, pull, commit, and push operations
Integrates optional OpenViking MCP memory services
